_note: One-shot proposals written from the brief alone (window, account list, causes already explained, schema). The residual was never shown. Caveat: this file is keyed by the held-out cause, so the writer knew which verifier was removed; ModelProposer is not told that. Treat the score as a bound on the adjudicator, not a measurement of the model.

normal_fee.name: gateway_fee_on_captures
normal_fee.title: Gateway fee charged on captured payments
normal_fee.rationale: fee_expense moves on capture and on settlement; the capture half is the ordinary gateway fee
normal_fee.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'fee_expense' AND event_type = 'payment_captured' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

gst_on_fee.name: gst_on_gateway_fee
gst_on_fee.title: GST charged on the gateway fee
gst_on_fee.rationale: gst_input_credit is claimed by nothing in the explained list
gst_on_fee.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'gst_input_credit' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

tds_194o.name: tds_withheld_194o
tds_194o.title: TDS withheld under section 194-O
tds_194o.rationale: tds_receivable is unexplained and only section 194-O moves it
tds_194o.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'tds_receivable' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

fee_rate_increase.name: fee_billed_above_contract
fee_rate_increase.title: Fee billed above the contracted rate
fee_rate_increase.rationale: normal_fee is explained, so the remaining fee_expense movement is the overcharge
fee_rate_increase.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'fee_expense' AND event_type = 'payment_captured' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

refunds_issued.name: refunds_to_customers
refunds_issued.title: Refunds returned to customers
refunds_issued.rationale: the refunds account is unclaimed by anything in the explained list
refunds_issued.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'refunds' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

dispute_reserve_held.name: dispute_reserve_movement
dispute_reserve_held.title: Reserve held and released against disputes
dispute_reserve_held.rationale: dispute_reserve moves when a dispute opens and when it resolves; nothing explained claims it
dispute_reserve_held.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'dispute_reserve' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

route_split.name: revenue_routed_to_third_parties
route_split.title: Revenue split away to routed accounts
route_split.rationale: revenue carries gross capture and any share transferred onward
route_split.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'revenue' AND event_type = 'route_transfer' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

captured_not_yet_settled.name: receivable_awaiting_settlement
captured_not_yet_settled.title: Captured but not yet settled
captured_not_yet_settled.rationale: bank_holiday_delay explains part of the receivable; the ordinary T+2 wait is the rest
captured_not_yet_settled.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'gateway_receivable' AND event_type = 'payment_captured' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'

risk_hold.name: funds_under_risk_hold
risk_hold.title: Funds frozen by a risk hold
risk_hold.rationale: the on_hold account is unclaimed and only a risk hold moves it
risk_hold.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'on_hold' AND occurred_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-08'
